span.label: A SIGNED ERROR TERM, NOT A LIMITATIONS PARAGRAPH. The sample is over-representative of women, the well-educated and mental labourers, and the paper states the consequence per figure: `we may have OVERESTIMATED knowledge and rates of preventive practices and UNDERESTIMATED rates of positive attitudes`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the population the findings apply to is narrowed explicitly - `strictly speaking, our findings can only be generalized to Chinese populations of a relatively high socioeconomic status, particularly women`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: THE MEASURE IS DECLARED INADEQUATE BY THE PEOPLE WHO USED IT: the assessment of attitudes and practices is `unstandardized and inadequate` and, for want of time, `BOTH WERE MEASURED WITH TWO SIMPLE QUESTIONS ONLY`
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the paper names who is missing and why: vulnerable populations - older adults, rural people - have limited access to internet and online health information, which is the same channel the survey recruited through
